name: a generated district: the sun on the streets, roofs over the buildings, lamps inside

steps.shot: noon: streets in the sun, the buildings shaded but by their doors

steps.note: 1920 ticks a world hour: thirteen hours on is nine at night

steps.shot: nine at night: every house lit by its lamp, the bank by its rows of tubes

steps.note: the district's corner: the lightmap reaches past the edge, so the street lamps light the wasteland beside them

steps.shot: the corner at night: street lamps over the edge of the wasteland
